about.title: Your local Bolton heating engineer
about.text:
BoilerWizz is a Bolton heating and electrical business run by Hussain, an engineer customers describe as knowledgeable, polite and happy to go out of his way.

You deal with the person who does the work. He explains what's wrong, fixes it properly and makes sure you're sorted before he leaves. That's why so many customers call BoilerWizz again and recommend it to friends.

faqs.q: What should I do if my boiler stops working?
faqs.a: Check the pressure gauge and any fault code on the display, then give us a call. We'll talk it through and book a visit to diagnose and fix the problem.

faqs.q: Do you work evenings and weekends?
faqs.a: Yes. We're open until 8pm Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm on Saturdays and 9am to 5pm on Sundays.

faqs.q: How often should my boiler be serviced?
faqs.a: Once a year. Regular servicing keeps your boiler safe and efficient, and most manufacturers require it to keep the warranty valid.

faqs.q: Can you install a smart thermostat like Hive?
faqs.a: Yes. We fit and set up smart heating controls, including Hive, and show you how to use them.

faqs.q: Do you do electrical work too?
faqs.a: Yes. BoilerWizz offers heating and electrical services, so get in touch and tell us what you need.
